name: Ghafurov

queries.query: Ghafurov Tajikistan official cadastral parcel map registry GIS land cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Tajikistan Geoportal as a public map portal describing location lookup for homes, land parcels and objects, and the State Committee for Land Management and Geodesy as the national cadastre/registration custodian. No Ghafurov-local public parcel API or openly documented parcel geometry endpoint was qualified.

queries.query: Ғафуров Тоҷикистон кадастр харита қитъаи замин расмӣ; рақами кадастрии Ғафуров геопортал
queries.result: Ҷустуҷӯи расмии тоҷикӣ Geoportal.tj-ро ёфт, ки ҷойгиршавӣ ва рақами кадастрии объектҳои бақайдгирифташударо шарҳ медиҳад; сомонаи мақомоти ноҳияи Бобоҷон Ғафуров низ маҳалро тасдиқ мекунад. Хадамоти оммавии маҳаллии Ғафуров бо посухи беном ID-и қитъа ва геометрия тасдиқ нашуд.

registryEvidence.custodian: The State Committee for Land Management and Geodesy and its state registration enterprise are evidenced as national land-cadastre and immovable-property-registration custodians. Geoportal.tj is described as a public national map portal.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: National custodian and portal evidence do not establish a Ghafurov-local registry endpoint or citywide open parcel coverage; registryFound remains null. The local committee page is administrative custodian evidence, not a parcel geometry viewer.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as a citywide absence test.

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS verification failed because the server certificate was expired. No certificate exception was authorized or used; current JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS and parcel response could not be inspected.
HTTP 301 redirect to https://geoportal.tj/; the redirected HTTPS request then failed normal TLS verification.

HTTP 200. Official public registration/encumbrance list was reachable, but no parcel polygon, map service, public geometry schema, or Ghafurov-local parcel endpoint was exposed; unsafe owner/address details were not retained.
HTTP 200. Official description identifies the national land-management, cadastre, geodesy, cartography and immovable-property-registration remit; no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint.
HTTP 200. Official enterprise page describes digital map and plan production, including city plans, but no open parcel API, native parcel schema or CRS was exposed.
HTTP 200. Official district site confirms the local administrative area; no parcel viewer or public parcel geometry service was exposed.
